name: Mysterious Omen extends the range of Murder and Soul Shock
contract: Mysterious Omen 561108 is a passive SpellMod: Effect0 (SPELLMOD_RANGE) carries SpellFamilyFlags[1] bits 6 and 27, overlapping both Murder 500376 (SpellFamilyFlags[1]=64, bit6) and Soul Shock 803989 (SpellFamilyFlags[1]=134217736, bit27), base points 4 (raw 5 yards). Effect1 carries SpellFamilyFlags[0]=4194304, matching Shudder Scythe 572382 exactly (the talent-805708 replacement for Murder), base points 1 (raw 2 yards). Both are native SPELLMOD_RANGE applications; issue #2036 reported no handler exists, which this proves false.
